audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and wants.foe[2] both label the cleanse-heal ability 'Cozy Campfire (R)' / 'Cozy Campfire cleanse'.
audit.why: Per enemyAbilities, Cozy Campfire is Milio's W (a heal + attack-range zone with no cleanse per its text) and Breath of Life is his R (the ability whose text explicitly 'remove[s] crowd control effects from allies in range'). The cleanse belongs to Breath of Life (R), not Cozy Campfire.
audit.corrected: Renamed both instances to Breath of Life (R).

audit.why: Level chart (all Skill/Skill across full and content layers) already agrees with the packet's flat levelChart and the near-even 51.41% win rate; no chart contradiction here.

Both breakdown.early/mid and phases correctly frame this as a skill-even enchanter mirror with no hard engage on either side, matching both kits (no hardCC/dash on Milio outside R's cleanse-wave, which isn't a pick tool).

edits.before: Both ultimates are peel, not pick: your Wish (R) is a global heal, Milio's Cozy Campfire (R) is an AoE heal plus cleanse. Neither ult starts a fight, so the level-6 window is about out-healing incoming jungle ganks, not all-in on each other.
edits.after: Both ultimates are peel, not pick: your Wish (R) is a global heal, Milio's Breath of Life (R) is an AoE heal plus cleanse. Neither ult starts a fight, so the level-6 window is about out-healing incoming jungle ganks, not all-in on each other.
